name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 5 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2026-02-26, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.63 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
